name: Clear Conditional Purpose
description: Conditional expressions should be clear to follow and simple to understand.
purpose: AIs and Humans should have no problem understanding the product level, architecture level, or business level decision behind each logical fork.
defaultAgentRecommendation:
When fixing following problem, evaluate each of the remarks, and derive an understandable and self documenting constant name.

Then present user with table that contains following columns:
- Remark id
- Link to file (name:line)
- Recommended constant name
- Current statements and terms.
